summary.text: David Kemp, a candidate on the 4 Our Immigrants Party line, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Assembly District 28 to Andrew Hevesi, receiving 3.4% of the vote to Hevesi's 89.4%, according to unofficial results reported by Ballotpedia and Wikipedia.
Ballotpedia lists him among the Republican primary candidates who withdrew or were disqualified. Little other public information about him was found.

sources.title: New York State Assembly District 28 results 2026
